spans.s:
uda-kumbhá, m. water-jar; jar with
water.

udag-ayaná, n. north-course (of the
sun), or the half-year from the winter to
the summer solstice. [udañe.]

údagdaśa, a. having the seams upward.
[udañc + daśā, ‘fringe, border, seam.’]

udaṅ-mukha, a. having the face to the
north. [udañc, 1249a, 161.]

údañc [409b], a. directed upward; directed
northward (on account of the Himālayas),
cf. uttara), northerly; in cpds, udak,
1249a. [ud + añc, 407.]

udayá, m. a going up; rising (of the sun).
[√i (1148. 1a) + ud.]

udára, n. belly. [orig., perhaps, ‘rising,
swelling,’ √ṛ + ud: for mg, cf. the relation
of belly to AS. belgan, ‘swell.’]

udārá, a. (like Eng. exalted, i. e.) noble,
excellent. [√ṛ + ud, ‘rise.’]
